Base includes the kairo migration (Executor 2ae4fc8 -> kairo v0.6.0 ef821dc, DEC-048: namespace/include/target rename, weak-API cleanup) plus Messages thinking PR#80/#81. AGPL-3.0 unchanged.; MIRA-20261009-002: Messages SSE parser decodes real-provider max_tokens cutoff streams (orphan content_block_stop synthesized as empty closed blocks; tool_use arguments validated in finish(), tolerated only under stop_reason=max_tokens as a bounded Incomplete/MaxOutputTokens completion; upstream PR#87 https://github.com/Linductor-alkaid/mira/pull/87) Audit: docs/supply-chain/mira-thinking-20261007.md. MIRA-20261012-001: network stage deadline errors (dns/connect/TLS/write/read) carry a retryable=true mechanism hint while total-budget waits stay non-retryable, and the loop recovery whitelist admits the retryable deadline code (upstream PR#88 https://github.com/Linductor-alkaid/mira/pull/88, merge 57c3062); Mirage widens profile tls/write deadlines to 20s/30s and enables the bounded conversation-loop recovery budget (2) whenever the RULE-08 output envelope can fund it while keeping at least seven usable turns (turn capacity >= 10); scarcer budgets keep the previous fail-fast shape.; MNT-2026-10-14/15 prerequisite: kairo pin upgrade ef821dc (v0.6.0) -> 32027c2 (v0.7.0) via upstream PR#89 (merge 99461b3, master tip 43a0d36), additive release with zero code migration per upstream DEC-054 (tiered adoption: SchedulingMetrics via get_scheduling_metrics() available now, QoS labeling + AdaptiveScheduler deferred with recorded triggers, FeedbackAggregator bound to a wants_feedback() scheduler; CPU/GPU selection N/A). Audit: docs/supply-chain/mira-kairo-070-20261013.md.; DEC-085 prerequisite: Messages SSE parser classifies provider `error` events into the loop recovery whitelist (overloaded/rate-limit/timeout/transport retryable, client mistakes fatal under their own codes, unknown types fail closed) and tolerates trailing pings plus a repeated message_stop after message_stop while still failing post-terminal garbage (upstream PR#91 https://github.com/Linductor-alkaid/mira/pull/91, merge bb39738, closes upstream issue #90); Mirage consumes the retryable classification through the conversation loop's own recovery budget and keeps its bounded non-streaming retry as the last-resort layer.; DEC-085 follow-up (2026-10-13 manual-session diagnosis): ConversationLoop differentiates the recovery feedback for tolerated max_tokens cutoffs (status Incomplete with no usable text now asks for concise plain text only - no tool calls, no long deliberation - instead of the generic answer-with-text that reproduced the same truncation and burned the recovery budget; upstream PR#92 https://github.com/Linductor-alkaid/mira/pull/92, merge 5791d2d).; DEC-085 complete fix: ConversationLoop gains max_output_continuations (default 2, independent of recoveries) - a tolerated max_tokens cutoff (status Incomplete, reason MaxOutputTokens) is settled by bounded continuation instead of regeneration: partial protocol-allowed text is kept as the assistant turn and the model continues from the cut, a reply cut off mid tool call is discarded unexecuted, a deliberation-only cutoff is asked for concise plain text; exhaustion settles with an explicit output-limit summary. The generic recovery block keeps truncation-aware feedback for cutoffs reported without the MaxOutputTokens reason (upstream PR#93 https://github.com/Linductor-alkaid/mira/pull/93, merge 1befa45).; M8-11: maintainer-authorized live thinking preview consumes merged PR#94 commit 22d9577 (https://github.com/Linductor-alkaid/mira/pull/94), independent opt-in thinking sink with UTF-8 bounded latest snapshots; PR#94 merged with maintainer authorization on 2026-10-14. Audit: docs/supply-chain/mira-thinking-preview-20261014.md.; DEC-088 Phase 2 prerequisite: host-asserted input-reuse identity seam - optional ModelInputIdentityProvider / set_model_input_identity carrying InputReuseMeta (content_digest, host-held consecutive reuse_count, semantic_label), the loop rendering one Internal-authority system note as the last part of the primary user envelope from the third consecutive identical image supply, counted as ConversationLoopResult.supplied_input_reuse_annotations, byte-identical requests without the callback - plus the max_tokens continuation anchor differentiation (partial-text continue-from-last-50-chars anchor, discarded-incomplete-tool-call retry guidance, deliberation-only concise plain text) (upstream PR#95 https://github.com/Linductor-alkaid/mira/pull/95, merge 9e7b729, merged with authorization on 2026-10-14, all PR checks green); Mirage wires the identity through DesktopImageTurn's cross-turn digest/count and adds supply-time image degradation on the DEC-087 anchored remaining budget. Seam part of MIRA-20261014-005; ledger entry settles after the Mirage-side counter ships and is re-verified. Audit: docs/supply-chain/mira-input-reuse-20261014.md.; DEC-088 capability 2/3 prerequisite: optional ConversationLoop history compaction seam - set_history_transformer hands the canonical tool-history replay to the host once per assembled request and replays the returned list for that request only (loop-owned history never mutated, byte-identical assembly without the transformer), provider-valid contract (User/Assistant roles, paired tool calls), every failure shape (Error/exception/empty/System-or-empty-item) degrades to the raw replay with HistoryTransformDegraded events and result counters (upstream PR#96 https://github.com/Linductor-alkaid/mira/pull/96, merge 93e2eae, merged with authorization on 2026-10-14, all 24 PR checks green); resolves the seam part of MIRA-20261014-006 - Mirage consumes it through DesktopContextBuilder (tool segment through Layer 0 with desktop watermarks 0.45/0.70/0.90, pair-split collapse, role-faithful passthrough). Audit: docs/supply-chain/mira-history-compaction-20261014.md.
